title: STOP, hey, then a clear yes: restart and confirm the next step and time
origin: Issue #109: only a clear yes restarts, and the reply confirms the next step and time on the same plan

history.text: Sam! Page 61 tonight, nice. How did that chapter land?
good, slow start but it's picking up
Love that. Same time tomorrow: 10 pages at 7 on the couch, photo of the page you stop on.

plan.reason: Ten pages a night builds the habit without eating your evening.

whatWentWrong: New case for #109: before it, any text after STOP restarted ZOH's own texts.
shouldHaveHappened: STOP gets the fixed confirmation. "hey" gets a warm reply asking once whether they want to pick reading back up, with no restart. "yes let's go again" restarts (restart_coaching) and the reply confirms the next step and its time on the same plan (10 pages of Dune at 7 tonight on the couch, a photo of the page), short and glad, with no lecture about stopping.
